questions.prompt: OS design is a solved problem: there's one correct way to build an operating system.
Where should the design of an OS start?
Which two things affect the design at the very top?
options: The choice of hardware and the type of system
The user's favorite color and font
The compiler and the text editor
The number of daemons and the size of the registry

questions.prompt: Which goal appears on BOTH the user list and the system list? (one word)
User and system goals can conflict with each other.
Why do operating systems differ so much inside?
options: Every OS uses the same structure
Each strikes its own balance among vague and conflicting goals
System calls are illegal in some countries
